column3: “a man from each of their fathers’ tribes” renders “one man, one man for the tribe of his fathers.”
“the command of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD.”
“what the land is like” renders “what it is.”
“open camps” renders “camps (mahanim),” and “with fortifications” renders “in fortresses.”
“trees” renders “wood,” and “Make an effort” renders “strengthen yourselves.”
“at Lebo-hamath” may also be read “the entrance of Hamath.”
“they came” renders the singular “he came”; NASB puts the note on Hebron in parentheses, and “the descendants of Anak” renders “those born of the Anak.”
“the valley” renders “the wadi (nahal)” (also in verse 24), and “between two men” renders “by two.”
“they proceeded to come” renders “they went and came.”
“it certainly does flow” renders “also it flows.”
“the descendants of Anak” renders “those born of the Anak.”
“by all means” and “surely” render emphatic doubled verbs.
